title: One thread per intent, avenMAIA orchestrates
quote: The Claude Code mod should merge the worlds of intents and Claude threads: each intent becomes its own Claude thread, and one master session, avenMAIA, orchestrates between the intents and their threads.
means: Each AIP runs in its own Claude Code thread, which owns its record (aip/AIP-n) and its branch. avenMAIA is the one master session: you talk to it, it records your decisions, starts and steers the threads, relays their questions and merges their work. AIP-4's mod shows intents and threads as one.

reflection.checked: every decision before D-43 that held
